title: Keep the log of habits when transitioning from a guest to a logged user.
body:
Hey guys, I came back to the app after a couple of months and I I’ve been enjoying a lot. BUT, you have to fix the habit log. I set up a couple of ones without logging in and go some reason I decided to include my account and all my tracks are gone. 🫠
You should have a way of syncing older logs in the phone to the newly account logged. That’s my only complain and why I give it a 4 star. Otherwise great app.
author: pamellis_

title: Bom aplicativo e UI lindinha
body: Aplicativo simples de usar e bonito. Gostei da funcionalidade de acompanhar os dias que um hábito foi feito em forma de quadrados pintados no calendário do mês.

title: This is really well thought out!
body: James Clear did a great job at creating a simple, uncluttered and useful app that actually works at creating new habits or replacing bad ones.
